title: First Skywatcher observation: class 1 'tetra' formation during a 2021 war game

tellings.quote: games. On one of these war games in 2021 year we did observation. It turned out to be NAYA first class, and

plain: During a military war game in 2021, a team watching the sky recorded something they later rated as a first class sighting, a formation of objects they call a "tetra". James Valor of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call up UFOs, tells this as one of their first observations and says he took part, and he mentions a person he calls only Mr. K. If it happened as he says, it would mean unknown objects showed up during a planned military exercise.
